# Allegro Medical

> > Allegro Medical is a trusted online medical supplies store offering wholesale prices on catheters, urological products, and healthcare equipment since 1996.

Allegro Medical specializes in catheter products and urological supplies with a comprehensive range of Foley catheters, intermittent catheters, external catheters, and related accessories. The site serves both individual customers and registered accounts with order history and requisition management features.
